## Checklist

- [ ] Branch named `<type>/<issue-number>-<slug>`
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and CI is green
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or real customer data in the diff
- [ ] Docs updated (README, API spec, or an ADR if a decision was made)
- [ ] Under ~400 changed lines, or explained below why it could not be split
- [ ] Deployed to a preview or dev environment and checked there
